name: Bar Refrigeration
description:
Elanpro supplies back bar cooler that makes it easier for pubs, bars, restaurants, hotels, and cafes to keep their beverages chilled and ready for service. With one, two and three-door options, these coolers fit under counter spaces and can perform well in smaller bars and larger venues. Besides, this bar cooler has a glass door feature that helps the bartenders see the different drinks available and keep track of the stock during peak times.

Our back bar coolers operate from 2° C to 10° C, providing beverages ready for serving. Furthermore, the internal illumination system increases visibility, and the double-glass door ensures insulation and keeps drinks visible at the same time. The digital temperature controls make it easier to adjust the temperature when needed. The adjustable shelves enable the storage of bottles and cans of different sizes. It works well as undercounter storage, providing a sleek look in the bar area. Those models of coolers that are fitted with a locking mechanism will help keep drinks safe.

name: Cold Room
description:
Elanpro, are known for offering impeccable cold room solutions which are used in both commercial and industrial storage requirements. They are a perfect choice for offering consistent cooling for perishable goods, pharmaceuticals, and bulk storage. At present, we are supplying these to hotels, restaurants, food processing units, pharmaceutical facilities, and cold chain businesses. We understand that every commercial and industrial set-up comes with different requirements and that is why we are offering these in multiple configurations and capacities.

Our cold room is known for its energy-efficient working which makes it better to use them for long hours without worrying about operating cost. We use high-quality insulated panels in manufacturing them to maintain temperature stability. To ensure that they can be used for preserving perishable goods, we conduct multiple quality checks before their final delivery. They are easy to install and operate and we do offer technical support and warranty on them. We maintain strict hygiene standards and ensure proper cooling to help these cold rooms offer better cooling throughout their lifespan.

name: Confectionery Showcase
description:
Elanpro, we have become a reputed brand for providing premium refrigeration and display solutions for the food and hospitality industry. Our Confectionery Showcase and Cake Display Counter are helping bakeries, cafés, patisseries, and dessert outlets present their products attractively. Apart from displaying, these counters help maintain proper freshness due to their advanced cooling technology. This not only helps enhancing the visibility of cakes or pastries, but also let one preserve delicate desserts.

We have Cake Showcase and confectionery counters available in different styles and with multiple features. As they are used for showcasing desserts or cakes, they are manufactured using clear tempered glass to provide excellent visibility. Along with that, they are capable of maintaining a chilled environment, so that bakery items remain fresh and in best condition to consume. One can explore our diverse range of cake display counter and can choose according to their business needs.

name: Hard Top Freezer
description:
Elanpro provides hard top freezer for hotel kitchens, food distributors, and businesses that store frozen products in bulk. These are equipped with sturdy insulated lids, and their storage compartments are spacious. Some of the items that can be stored include ice cream, meat, fish, and various frozen food products.

Our hard top freezers come in different sizes ranging from 283 litres to 805 litres. They are designed to operate at 2-8°C for chilling or even freezing at temperatures as low as -25°C. In addition, these commercial freezers have added features like multiple access lids, storage baskets, and locking options for added convenience.

description:

name: Laboratory Freezer
description:
Elanpro provides laboratory freezer in multiple capacities for research, pathology, pharma labs, and other related applications. Our freezers are available in upright configurations with glass or solid doors. It is a specialized refrigeration unit that maintains controlled low temperatures and stores biological samples, chemicals, vaccines, and reagents. It is constructed to maintain the same cooling temperature with slight variation over a long time. We have fitted them with accurate temperature controls, alarms, and monitoring capabilities to make sure that stored materials are safe and usable. Our freezers have sealed drawers to prevent frost loss due to open doors. The microprocessor controller regulates the temperature, can automate defrost cycles, and signals the safety alarms when required.

Our lab freezer features a quick-freezing function with an energy-efficient A+ rating. Thick PUFF insulation prevents any heat exchange with the external environment. We have built in a heavy-duty condenser in view of the Indian conditions. For flexible storage, it has pull-out doors in multiple sizes. Through these incredible features, our freezers preserve valuable samples and support experiments and overall lab operations with ease in the long run. By keeping the sensitive materials at the right temperature, our freezer prevents issues such as sample deterioration and unexpected storage failures.

name: Mini Bar & Mini Fridge
description:
Elanpro’s mini bar & mini fridge are excellent for storing perishable foods and beverages in compact spaces. We build these refrigerators to be used in homes, hotels, bars, clubs, and other applications where they need a small cooling unit. We provide them in solid-door and glass-door options. The construction of the walls is based on robust insulation, keeping the interior temperature between 2~10°C. The net volume capacity of our mini fridge ranges from 48 to 92 Ltrs, while the mini bars range from 30 to 40 Ltrs. Each of the units is energy-efficient, consuming a minimal amount of energy. They are equipped with safety features for long-lasting performance.

Our mini fridge can be used in office spaces to keep personal lunches, yogurt, coffee creamers, and cold beverages at a desired cool temperature. The multiple shelves are adjustable to accommodate bottles or containers of different sizes for maximum space utilization. For portable cruise cabins, dorm rooms, and kitchens with limited space, our mini fridge is the best option. The mini bars are constructed with a reversible door, which is suitable for tight spaces. Their flexibility, reliable cooling performance, and long-lasting cooling effect make them the sought-after appliances for restaurants, executive cabins, cruise ships, and homes. Our mini bar & fridge are designed with aesthetic considerations to maintain the visual appeal of the space. If you are searching for a mini fridge or mini bar, get in touch with our support team.

name: Softy Ice Cream Machine
description:
Elanpro, has successfully captured the Indian market through its well-functioned beverage and dessert equipment and our Softy Ice Cream Machine is one of them. Be it the busy food courts or amusement parks, hotel dessert counters or ice cream parlors, they all require equipment that prepares and deliver soft serve ice cream with perfect creamy texture. Our commercial soft serve machines align well with these market demands as they offer uniform freezing, smooth dispensing, and are easy to handle, even during peak service hours.

By keeping commercial use in consideration, we always offer softy ice cream machines that are suitable for heavy commercial usage. Their user-friendly features have made them an apt choice for dessert kiosks, cafes, quick service restaurants, and ice-cream parlors. The best part about these machines is that they maintain ideal temperature required for maintaining that creamy soft serve texture. Their automated freezing and dispensing feature is what makes them a better choice in the Indian market.
